theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x + y = 2) : x * y ≤ 1 := by
  have h_y : y = 2 - x := by rw [h]
  have h_product : x * y = x * (2 - x) := by rw [h_y]
  have h_simplified : x * y = 2 * x - x ^ 2 := by simp [h_product]
  have h_max : 2 * x - x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have h_ineq : (x - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by simp
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, pow_two] at h_ineq
    have h_expanded : x ^ 2 - 2 * x + 1 ≥ 0 := by simp [h_ineq]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, pow_two] at h_expanded
    have h_rearranged : x ^ 2 - 2 * x ≤ 1 := by
      rw [add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_sub_assoc]
      exact h_expanded
    exact h_rearranged
  exact h_max
